name: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
description: Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and "geeks out" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace.

videos.title: Holiday Special
videos.overview: The Winter Festival is coming and Po is asked to host the great exclusive formal banquet for all the Masters of Kung Fu. However, the occasion is on the same night as his father's restaurant's own party and Mr. Ping, upset at his son's absence, will not cancel it to cook for the masters at Po's request. Burdened by his father's imposed guilt about his conflicting responsibilities, Po finds all the preparations a dispiriting struggle. However, the solution comes from where he least expects it even as the panda must decide who truly needs him more on the big night.

videos.title: Secrets of the Furious Five
videos.overview: With Po's status as the Dragon Warrior proven to all, Master Shifu has a new challenge for him; teaching Introduction to Kung Fu class to a bunch of a rambunctious bunny children. After getting the class to come to order, Po teaches them that fighting is only part of kung fu, while its true meaning is "Excellence of Self." To explain this philosophy, Po tells stories of each of his comrades, The Furious Five, and how they faced formative challenges in their youth that helped define them as true masters of kung fu.

videos.title: Secrets of the Scroll
videos.overview: As Po looks for his lost action figures, the story of how the panda inadvertently helped create the Furious Five is told.

videos.title: Scorpion's Sting
videos.overview: Po and Monkey race to find a sacred orchid to cure a sick Tigress. But Monkey is hypnotized by the evil Scorpion into hunting down another target -- Po.

videos.title: The Princess and the Po
videos.overview: Po is put in charge of protecting the Emperor’s daughter while on a diplomatic trip to visit the Qidan clan. Luckily, Tigress and Mantis are along for the journey.

videos.title: Sticky Situation
videos.overview: Po destroys the training hall whilst cleaning it and needs to repair it quickly before Shifu finds out. He seeks out the builder of the hall, Taotie, who holds a grudge against Shifu.

videos.title: Chain Reaction
videos.overview: While transporting an important column, Po and Tigress’s attempt to defend it against bandits is complicated when they are chained together.

videos.title: Fluttering Finger Mindslip
videos.overview: Po learns a new move by jumping ahead of reading fifty sacred scrolls and ends up wiping the memories of the Furious Five.

videos.title: Good Croc, Bad Croc
videos.overview: Po is tricked into saving the leader of the Croc Bandits’ brother when in fact he has kidnapped the son of a powerful landowner.

videos.title: Hometown Hero
videos.overview: Mantis gets help from Po after receiving word his ex-fiancée needs help, which he is reluctant to take as his hometown believes Mantis to be the Dragon Warrior.

videos.title: Jailhouse Panda
videos.overview: Po goes undercover as a prisoner in Chor Ghom Prison to learn where a diabolical criminal has hidden the ultra-dangerous weapon, the Sacred War Hammer of Lei Lang.

videos.title: Owl Be Back
videos.overview: The Furious Five discover that Po has incredible kung fu abilities far beyond anyone else’s in the group. This worries them as they believe he will turn evil like Fenghuang, a member of the Furious Five before the current team who was also greatly powerful.

videos.title: Bad Po
videos.overview: Po has split himself into two opposing parts by looking through the Mystic Mirror of Yin and Yang and needs to stop his duplicate from destroying his reputation and friendships with his bad personality traits.

videos.title: Sight for Sore Eyes
videos.overview: When a villainous rival of Master Shifu manipulates Po into breaking an important rule, the consequences allow him to become Grand Master of the Jade Palace.

videos.title: Rhino's Revenge
videos.overview: Hundun, a former guard at Chor Ghom prison, wants revenge against the Dragon Warrior for making him lose everything in his life as a result of defeating Tai Lung.

videos.title: Master Ping
videos.overview: Shifu invites Mr. Ping to stay at the Jade Palace when his noodle shop is badly damaged during a fight between Po, Monkey and three pig brothers. This causes tension between him and the others until he is asked to leave and is subsequently captured by the pig brothers believing him to be Master Shifu.

videos.title: Ghost of Oogway
videos.overview: Po encounters the ghost of Master Oogway, who seems strangely bent on causing dissension in the Jade Palace.

videos.title: The Kung Fu Kid
videos.overview: When a kung fu prodigy arrives at the Jade Palace, Po’s enthusiasm begins to sour when he gets a little jealous of the attention being heaped onto the young master.

videos.title: Ladies of the Shade
videos.overview: Po befriends a troupe of dancers, unaware that they are actually a band of traveling thieves. When a prized item goes missing from the Jade Palace, Po has to disguise himself to infiltrate the band.

videos.title: Big Bro Po
videos.overview: Po must look after Taotie's son after he is taken to prison after a failed attack on the Jade Palace. His loyalties are split when he tries to help his father get out of prison though he has warmed to Po.

videos.title: Po Fans Out
videos.overview: Po finds he has a fan club in the valley but they are unimpressed when they find the Dragon Warrior's day to day life isn't as action packed as they imagined. With this newfound attention flagging, Po releases a demon in order to fight it and impress his fan club.

videos.title: Challenge Day
videos.overview: It's Dragon Warrior Challenge Day, and if anyone can defeat Po in battle before sundown, they will become the Dragon Warrior.

videos.title: My Favorite Yao
videos.overview: Shifu's personal hero arrives at the Jade Palace, but in his overenthusiasm, Shifu accidentally lets him run amok while Temutai schemes to abduct him.

videos.title: In With the Old
videos.overview: When the Furious Five go out of town and the Jade Palace is attacked, Po has to rely on a team of elderly Mahjong players for back-up.

videos.title: Has-Been Hero
videos.overview: Po's kung fu hero comes to town for an exhibition match.

videos.title: Love Stings
videos.overview: Po sets up his father, Mr. Ping, on a series of unsuccessful dates, only to find out Mr. Ping already has a girlfriend. Po's happiness for his dad is short lived when he finds out the mystery lady's identity.

videos.title: Hall of Lame
videos.overview: Po needs to find an awesome Dragon Warrior trophy for the Hall of Heroes or be humiliated in front of the entire village at the upcoming Warrior Festival.

videos.title: Father Crime
videos.overview: When Shifu's con-man father comes back into town, Po finds himself in the middle.

videos.title: Monkey in the Middle
videos.overview: The villagers are outraged over a rash of thefts in the Valley of Peace.

videos.title: Kung Fu Day Care
videos.overview: Tigress must babysit a child who has been separated from his parents. The Croc Bandits are trying to kidnap him for a ransom.

videos.title: Royal Pain
videos.overview: Master Shifu and the Furious Five meet their newest trainee – The Emperor's Grandson!

videos.title: The Most Dangerous Po
videos.overview: While visiting a famous war hero named General Tsin, Po discovers that the retired general has lost his mind.

videos.title: The Po Who Cried Ghost
videos.overview: Po comes face to face with hopping ghosts called Jiang Shi which have been sighted around the Valley of Peace's cemetery.

videos.title: Kung Shoes
videos.overview: Po buys shoes that promise to make him better at Kung Fu without the training, but the shoes were created with evil magic and threaten the Furious Five.

videos.title: Bosom Enemies
videos.overview: After being defeated by Po, Taotie has a nervous breakdown.

videos.title: Enter the Dragon (1)
videos.overview: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 1 of 2.

videos.title: Enter the Dragon (2)
videos.overview: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 2 of 2.

videos.title: Master and the Panda
videos.overview: Po's the only one unhappy when Peng returns to town, because Po knows who Peng's uncle is.

videos.title: Present Tense
videos.overview: Po takes a job as a bounty hunter to earn money to buy his father a gift.

videos.title: Shifu's Back!
videos.overview: Po must sit in as master of the Jade Palace when Shifu hurts his back.

videos.title: Terror Cotta
videos.overview: Fung finds an old scroll with instructions for making living terra cotta warriors, and soon it's up to Po and the Furious Five to stop his monstrous clay creations.

videos.title: The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding
videos.overview: When Po is possessed by the ghost of the evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.

videos.title: The Maltese Mantis
videos.overview: Po and Mantis visit the equivalent of an ancient Chinese Comic-Con, where Po’s fanboy enthusiasm gets out of hand.

videos.title: Invitation Only
videos.overview: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of the evil Temutai and his army?

videos.title: The Midnight Stranger
videos.overview: When kung fu is outlawed, Po turns to donning a mask to fight crime.

videos.title: Shoot the Messenger
videos.overview: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

videos.title: A Tigress Tale
videos.overview: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

videos.title: Crane on a Wire
videos.overview: Po tries to help Crane get his "mojo" back after he is humiliated at a charity event.

videos.title: The Secret Museum of Kung Fu
videos.overview: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.

videos.title: Bride of Po
videos.overview: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior.

videos.title: Five is Enough
videos.overview: Master Chao visits the valley to oversee a Tournament. Shifu is convinced that Po and Master Chao want to replace him. Shifu's old enemy, Pai Mei, arrives in the middle of the tournament and threatens to destroy Shifu.

videos.title: Mama Told Me Not to Kung Fu
videos.overview: When Crane's mother visits the Valley of Peace, Crane asks his friends to help him keep a secret from her.

videos.title: Secret Admirer
videos.overview: Po plays a prank on Monkey with a fake love letter and their relationship is tested.

videos.title: Qilin Time
videos.overview: After his father takes him on a wild goose chase, Po becomes embarrassed.

videos.title: Huge
videos.overview: Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge and inadvertently puts himself and his friends in danger.

videos.title: Shifu's Ex
videos.overview: When Shifu's thieving ex-girlfriend visits the Jade Palace seeking redemption, Shifu quickly learns she wants more than simple forgiveness.

videos.title: War of the Noodles
videos.overview: Hundun opens up a noodle shop in the village, threatening to put Mr. Ping out of business.

videos.title: The Break Up
videos.overview: Po and Mr. Ping must make things right when two Croc Bandits have a spat.

videos.title: Mind Over Manners
videos.overview: Po is struck by lightning which gives him the power to read minds.

videos.title: A Thousand and Twenty Questions
videos.overview: Master Yao announces that anyone who brings him a new wonder will be allowed to ask him a single question.

videos.title: The Way of the Prawn
videos.overview: Despite Po's objections, Shifu calls in a samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

videos.title: Mouth Off
videos.overview: Shifu suggests that Po should take a vow of silence to help with his focus.

videos.title: Serpent's Tooth
videos.overview: The villagers begin to adopt an anti-snake sentiment when Fu-xi turns renegade and attacks the Valley of Peace.

videos.title: The Goosefather
videos.overview: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout.

videos.title: Po Picks a Pocket
videos.overview: Po befriends a group of orphans who have been stealing money and goods from the villagers.

videos.title: Croc You Like a Hurricane
videos.overview: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

videos.title: Crazy Little Ling Called Love
videos.overview: Po is suspicious when Shifu gets back together with his evil ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling.

videos.title: Kung Fu Club
videos.overview: Shifu sends Po to shut down an underground fight club.

videos.title: The Hunger Game
videos.overview: Po and the Five must stop food-stealing rats to end a famine, but Po's weakness for food may hinder the mission.

videos.title: A Stitch in Time
videos.overview: Po discovers the seeds of Shuyong: magical items that can actually take the user back in time. After Po disobeys Shifu, evil Fenghuang steals one of the seeds, putting the entire world in danger.

videos.title: Eternal Chord
videos.overview: Po's qi is out of balance, and Shifu and wise Master Lun attempt to re-harmonize the panda using the ancient tradition of musical kung fu.

videos.title: Apocalypse Yao
videos.overview: Mystic secrets are stolen from Master Yao's head, so the master turns to Po for help.

videos.title: The Real Dragon Warrior
videos.overview: Po and Monkey discover a small village and meet an impostor claiming to be the Dragon Warrior.

videos.title: Youth in Re-Volt
videos.overview: Bian Zao steals magical lightning powers.

videos.title: Forsaken and Furious
videos.overview: The furious five quit the Jade Palace and head out on their own.

videos.title: Po the Croc
videos.overview: Po is left with amnesia after a blow to the head.

videos.title: Camp Ping
videos.overview: Shifu and Mr. Ping compete for Po's attention.

videos.title: Goose Chase
videos.overview: Zeng unhappily quits his job at the Palace.

videos.title: The First Five
videos.overview: Po hosts a reunion for the First Furious Five, and Shifu's heroic legacy is questioned at the gathering.

videos.title: See No Weevil
videos.overview: General Tsin has a conspiracy theory about alien rice weevils taking over the world.

videos.title: Emperors Rule (1)
videos.overview: Po becomes head of Imperial Security when Lu Kang returns. Part 1 of 2.

videos.title: Emperors Rule (2)
videos.overview: Po becomes head of Imperial Security when Lu Kang returns. Part 2 of 2.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 13 wins & 34 nominations total
